title: Restaurant Inspection Alert — Brandt

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: This is Mr. Hector Ruiz, owner of El Sol Mexican Restaurant in Brandt. I just got a call from a health inspector — says I have to close for 72 hours because of a measles outbreak. But I haven’t seen any cases, and my staff all have full MMR coverage. My license is still valid. Is this a mistake?

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: Mr. Ruiz, thank you for calling. We’re looking into this. I’ll check the inspection status in EnviroTrack and get back to you within the hour.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I don’t understand — I’ve been open for 14 years, and this is the first time I’ve been told to close. I need to know if this is real.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the Environmental Health role should verify the inspection in EnviroTrack. If not present, they must log the call via paper form MCHD-F-20 and note as unverified.
